text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

1. Reps got time back. Post-call admin dropped from roughly 25 minutes to under 10. That meant more selling, less typing in the parking lot.

2. CRM quality improved. Notes were consistent, searchable, and actually completed. Managers finally saw next steps without chasing.

3. Consent matters. Some customers hesitated. Reps who asked upfront and explained the "why" earned trust instead of losing it.

4. Summaries aren't strategy. The tool captured what was said, not what it meant. Reps still had to read between the lines.

5. Adoption followed coaching, not mandates.

Our verdict: keep it, but treat it as an assistant, not a replacement for judgment.

What has your team learned from AI tools?
